visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman stands in a brightly lit subway station entrance, wearing a white cap with a yellow logo and a black t-shirt. She holds a red and orange gradient Tmoney card toward the camera, speaking with animated expressions. The background shows station stairs and turnstiles. (2) The scene cuts to another woman in a grey t-shirt laughing and walking within the same subway station environment. The camera follows her movement briefly before returning to the first speaker. (3) A digital interface screen recording appears, showing the App Store. A finger types 'Tmoney' into the search bar, revealing several mobile payment and transit apps. (4) The screen recording details the process of installing the 'Mobile Tmoney' app and navigating its initial setup screens in Korean. Purple and white buttons are pressed sequentially. (5) The interface shifts to the Apple Wallet integration process. On-screen prompts show the Tmoney card being added to Apple Pay, followed by a checkmark indicating successful addition. (6) The camera switches back to a first-person perspective, showing a hand holding an iPhone with the virtual Tmoney card over a 'Ticket Vending and Card Reload' machine. The user selects English/Chinese language options on the touchscreen and chooses a reload amount of 3,000 KRW. (7) A physical 1,000 KRW bill is inserted into the machine's glowing bill acceptor. The screen updates to show the transaction progress and final balance. (8) The person holds their iPhone over a subway turnstile sensor. A custom wallet card animation appears on the screen, and the gate releases, allowing them to pass through the ticket barrier.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 你們知道現在在韓國搭地鐵. [Logo]: Kodak. (2) [Subtitle]: 實體Tmoney卡了嗎. (3) [Variety]: (老派丟). (4) [Variety]: (自己撿). (5) [Subtitle]: 太俗了吧. (6) [Subtitle]: 教你怎麼把韓國的Tmoney卡. (7) [Subtitle]: 綁進手機裡面. (8) [Subtitle]: 首先先搜尋Tmoney App. (9) [Subtitle]: 找到這個直接按下下載. (10) [Subtitle]: 打開後紫色的按鍵給它按下去. (11) [Subtitle]: 接著按下面的Browsing. (12) [Subtitle]: 再點選手機、手錶這個圖示. (13) [Subtitle]: Agree To All 敢敢給它按下去. (14) [Subtitle]: 接著會回到這個畫面. (15) [Subtitle]: 點選你的錢包. (16) [Subtitle]: 加入卡片 點選下一步. (17) [Subtitle]: 它就會聯絡發卡的機構. (18) [Subtitle]: 設定可以用於Apple Pay. (19) [Subtitle]: 再幫你加入到手機的錢包裡面. (20) [Subtitle]: 耶加入完成. (21) [Subtitle]: 接著再設定快速模式. (22) [Subtitle]: 只要手機靠近感應區就可以逼卡. (23) [Subtitle]: 按兩下開關鍵的鍵. (24) [Subtitle]: 就會發現Tmoney已經在你的錢包裡面囉. (25) [Subtitle]: 可是它儲值也沒那麼簡單. (26) [Subtitle]: 一定要到地鐵的機台或者是CU也可以. (27) [Subtitle]: 首先打開你錢包裡面的Tmoney卡. (28) [Subtitle]: 右上角三個點點按「卡片詳細資訊」. (29) [Subtitle]: 往下滑之後找到「開啟服務模式」. (30) [Subtitle]: 對著你的臉按兩下「確認」. (31) [Subtitle]: 就可以把手機放在儲值的機台上. (32) [Subtitle]: 按交通卡儲值 選擇你要儲值的金額. (33) [Subtitle]: 把錢放進去機台裡面. (34) [Subtitle]: 這樣就儲值完成囉. (35) [Subtitle]: 拿出來的時候就會顯示你儲值的金額了. (36) [Subtitle]: 最後當你朋友還在找卡片的時候. (37) [Subtitle]: 你不需要打開手機畫面. (38) [Subtitle]: 只要拿出手機這樣子「逼」一下. (39) [Subtitle]: 炫炮出去.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-energy female narration in Mandarin. An upbeat, major-key electronic BGM with a steady 4/4 house beat and synthetic lead lines underpins the speech. The acoustic environment is clean with a slight indoor resonance. (2) A sharp, mid-frequency 'thud' SFX occurs as a card hits the floor, accompanied by a brief shift in vocal inflection to a playful tone. (3) A sequence of technical instructions follows. Each screen tap in the visual is punctuated by a high-pitched digital 'click' or 'pop' SFX. The speech rate is rapid but clearly articulated. (4) A percussive 'ding' SFX marks the completion of the card addition to the digital wallet. The BGM maintains a consistent intensity. (5) The sound of a mechanical bill acceptor whirring is heard as cash is inserted into a machine. This incidental noise has a broadband spectral texture. (6) A final electronic 'beep' SFX from the turnstile sensor signals a successful gate entry. The narration concludes with a triumphant, rising intonation as the BGM fades out.
